ui.searchPlaceholder: Problems, tools, and your next step

brief.audience: For research, news, operations, and office teams
brief.casesTitle: What problems have I worked on?
brief.casesSubtitle: Start with a problem your team recognizes.

cases.title: Lots of documents, hard-to-find answers
cases.problem: Finding one fact means opening report after report.
cases.solution: Report and announcement Q&A: ask in everyday language and find relevant passages and sources.
cases.result: Spend less time searching and check the original source.

cases.title: Useful data trapped in documents
cases.problem: Scanned text and report tables have to be copied and organized by hand.
cases.solution: Document processing: extract text and tables for search and further analysis.
cases.result: Reduce repetitive data entry and leave more time for checking and analysis.

cases.title: Updates copied between systems
cases.problem: People watch inboxes and re-enter the same updates in spreadsheets and business systems.
cases.solution: Email alerts and Lark sync: route key information and synchronize records.
cases.result: Reduce manual copying and missed updates.

brief.toolsSubtitle: Each tool below has an existing implementation to build on. Start with one small task.
brief.toolsNote: Reuse means building on existing work. A trial depends on sample data, account permissions, and the setup needed to run it.

tools.title: Collect report attachments
tools.output: Collect attachments and extract relevant table data.
tools.setup: Connect the mailbox and define attachment filters and fields.

tools.title: Important email alerts
tools.fit: People who keep checking their inbox
tools.output: Filter important emails and send their contents to a chosen chat tool.
tools.setup: Set filtering rules and the message destination.

tools.title: Sort announcements and news
tools.fit: Teams organizing large volumes of news
tools.output: Label content for filtering, summaries, and distribution.
tools.setup: Agree on categories and check the results against samples.

tools.title: Extract scanned text and tables
tools.fit: Teams turning scanned documents into usable data
tools.output: Extract text and identify tables to reduce manual entry.
tools.setup: Check recognition quality and output format before connecting it.

tools.title: Sync Lark and business records
tools.fit: Teams maintaining the same records in two places
tools.input: Lark tables and the business records to synchronize.
tools.output: Sync order status and customer or supplier details.
tools.setup: Map fields, agree on sync rules, and configure system access.

tools.title: Intraday ETF alerts
tools.input: ETFs to watch and alert conditions.
tools.output: Monitor changes and send an alert when conditions are met.
tools.setup: Confirm the market data source, indicators, and alert channel.

brief.conversationTitle: Three questions to ask a finance team
questions: Which repetitive task takes the most time every day?
Where does the data live, and can you share a sample?
What would a useful result from a small trial look like?
brief.conversationNote: Start with collecting reports, sorting news, or organizing tables. A sample helps establish what can be reused and what needs custom work.
